methodology.classification: Good, needs improvement, or poor thresholds are applied to the 75th percentile of field visits, segmented by device where field data supports it.
methodology.note: These are published reference thresholds. They are not AfricaLatency measurements, African country averages, or carrier rankings.

core_web_vitals.name: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
core_web_vitals.description: Measures loading performance by tracking when the largest visible content element is rendered.

core_web_vitals.name: Interaction to Next Paint (INP)
core_web_vitals.description: Measures responsiveness across user interactions during a page visit.

core_web_vitals.name: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
core_web_vitals.description: Measures unexpected visual movement of page content.

supporting_metrics.name: First Contentful Paint (FCP)
supporting_metrics.description: A supporting loading metric; it is not one of the three Core Web Vitals.

supporting_metrics.name: Time to First Byte (TTFB)
supporting_metrics.description: A diagnostic server-response metric. Google PageSpeed Insights labels these TTFB thresholds experimental.

africa_latency_benchmarks.reason: No representative, validated dataset is currently published for country-wide or carrier-wide performance rankings.
africa_latency_benchmarks.policy: Do not infer country or carrier rankings from isolated scan results or probe availability.

sources.name: Core Web Vitals thresholds and methodology
